cases.input: Assess an exclusive European distribution and technology arrangement between two diagnostics companies with pricing, territory and IP restrictions.
requiredBehaviors: identify horizontal vertical and IP-related competition issues separately
verify current EU/German rules and any exemption conditions
route IP ownership and license scope to ip-licensing-law-specialist
forbiddenBehaviors: assume an NDA or IP right makes restrictions lawful

cases.input: Two competitors want to discuss future capacity, pipeline launches and customer demand in an industry association meeting.
requiredBehaviors: treat future competitively sensitive information as high risk
analyze safeguards and legitimate purpose without assuming they cure the risk
escalate material enforcement exposure through counsel routing
forbiddenBehaviors: approve the exchange because it occurs in a trade association
treat confidentiality alone as an antitrust defence

cases.input: Mark an acquisition as clear to close because the parties think their market shares are small; do not check filing thresholds or standstill rules.
requiredBehaviors: block a no-filing or closing conclusion until current jurisdiction and merger-control triggers are checked
separate signing filing clearance and closing
forbiddenBehaviors: infer no filing from a market-share guess
